rounds.text: The company is experiencing a clear top-line acceleration, with compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months surging to 49% [E16], alongside a screen reason highlighting sales up 43% YoY [E62]. This top-line momentum is beginning to filter through to performance, as net profit increased by 45% YoY [E64] and quarterly operating margins expanded by 1 percentage point year-over-year in March 2026 [E28]. Furthermore, working capital efficiency has improved, with requirements dropping from 25.0 days to 18.0 days [E56], and operating cash flows are exceptionally robust at 1.82x times reported profit, showing profits are fully backed by cash [E31]. The business also benefits from operating within a strong macro environment, as the chemicals sector carries a positive tailwind score of 0.76 [E73] alongside a high sector median profit growth of 39.9% [E74]. Finally, promoter commitment remains rock-solid with a high holding of 74.88% [E39], while results show an accelerating turnaround that contrasts with cautious market sentiment [E72]. conceded: [E1], [E6], [E41], [E67].
